source: Draft a report summary: sensor A measured 12.0 mV at 20 °C. Reported uncertainty is ±0.2 mV; its coverage basis is not supplied. Three readings were taken.
expectations: Keep 12.0 mV, ±0.2 mV, 20 °C, and three readings.
Flag missing uncertainty basis rather than label it a 95% interval.

source: The audience is electrical engineers. Keep the term impedance; replacing it with resistance would change the technical claim.
expectations: Retain impedance and explain it if necessary.
Do not replace the term solely for everyday vocabulary.

source: A figure shows only tests at 20 °C, with n=3. The observed trend may not extend to colder conditions.
expectations: Carry test temperature, sample count, and limited generalization into the caption or accompanying text.
Do not claim performance at all temperatures.
knownBadRewrite: The device performs this way at every temperature.

source: Summarize the NIST-4 result reported in 2017. Over 10,000 weighings yielded h = 6.626 069 934(89) × 10⁻³⁴ J s with relative standard uncertainty 13 × 10⁻⁹.
expectations: Attribute the historical estimate, instrument, unit and relative standard uncertainty. Do not label it a 95% interval.
